question: Under matched Temporal configuration and hermetic work, what semantic, recovery, diagnosability, and parity-gated efficiency differences are caused by inserting one Child Workflow per fixed logical item?

scale_policy.selection_rule: Run each case's unfaulted baseline and primary protected boundary at fan-outs 8, 32, and 128; run the primary unsafe control and every secondary unsafe/protected boundary only at fan-out 32.
scale_policy.rationale: This identifies nonlinear topology cost and protected recovery behavior while retaining every dangerous boundary without an uninformative full Cartesian product.

recovery_bounds.bound_role: Correctness and infrastructure-liveness admission only; never an efficiency estimand.

admission.efficiency_gate: All thirty valid matched pairs must have both topology arms pass correctness, safety, liveness, and diagnosability before any efficiency estimate is interpreted.
admission.unsafe_gate: Both topology arms must exhibit the case's preregistered prohibited outcome or bound violation under the common unsafe control; a false pass rejects the case/probe apparatus.
admission.unfaulted_gate: Both topology arms must reach identical expected logical output with zero prohibited actions.
admission.protected_gate: Both topology arms must reach the expected logical disposition within the liveness ceiling with zero prohibited actions and complete causal evidence.
admission.invalid_policy: Retain the complete append-only episode and use the next predetermined reserve pair; never delete, overwrite, or convert invalid evidence into a logical pass or failure.
invalid_reasons: named barrier not reached or reached by the wrong identity
fault not bracketed by the preregistered causal events
required raw evidence missing, malformed, outside the sealed root, or hash-mismatched
arm inputs, Activity options, host envelope, or source hashes differ
setup, readiness, teardown, or cleanup fails
lineage graph has a missing required identity or causal edge

analysis.ratio_rule: report ratios only when both paired values are positive
analysis.scale_rule: Report each fan-out stratum independently plus per-item history values and observed between-stratum changes; do not fit or extrapolate a universal asymptotic model.
analysis.failed_parity_rule: Retain and report all binary outcomes and raw metrics, but mark efficiency unresolved for any matched stratum that fails admission.

diagnosability.required_chain: tracker Bead and schedule block -> parent Workflow/Run -> logical item -> optional Child Workflow/Run -> Activity attempts -> Worker and process/session -> dependency and destination events -> outcome -> acknowledgement

pilot_policy.apparatus_defect_policy: Preserve the failed pilot and raw evidence. Fix in-scope implementation defects under review authorization. If a case, boundary, oracle, scale, estimand, or analysis rule must change, issue a new preregistration version with explicit supersession lineage before any publication run.
freeze_after_pilot: Temporal Server, CLI, Go SDK, and Go versions

host_controls: same pinned host and runtime envelope
condition-based idle readiness before each arm
sequential arm execution within randomized pairs
identical Worker count and Activity concurrency
setup and teardown outside measured intervals
recorded CPU, memory, process, Temporal, Go, and source identities
change_policy: No pilot or publication result may silently change the frozen cases, topology arms, fan-out ladder, boundary matrix, probes, admission, estimands, or analysis. Any necessary semantic change creates a new protocol version and preserves all earlier artifacts and evidence.
review_authorization: Reviewers are authorized to implement all in-scope correctness, evidence-integrity, determinism, race, replay, security, and maintainability fixes without pausing for human approval. Commit, push, remote sync, publication, destructive operations, credential repurposing, and material scope expansion remain outside that authorization.
falsifiers: the two arms execute different work Activity code, inputs, Activity options, retry ownership, task queues, Worker limits, or destination protocol
a Child Workflow adds retries or business behavior beyond scheduling the identical work Activity
dynamic membership, physical Activity attempts, or unordered map iteration determines join or reduction readiness
a fault is selected with a timing guess instead of an exact named barrier
the unsafe control cannot violate the invariant or bound it was designed to distinguish
an invalid, failed, or excluded episode is deleted, overwritten, or filtered by outcome
items or Activity attempts within an episode are treated as independent statistical samples
pilot evidence enters publication analysis or chooses favorable scales, boundaries, estimands, admission, or analysis
arm or stratum order differs from the frozen seeded schedule
a required Temporal history is missing or fails replay with the frozen Worker code
efficiency is interpreted after either matched arm fails correctness, safety, liveness, or diagnosability
the analyzer cannot reconstruct a primary metric from sealed raw anchors
a result is described as exactly once, a universal topology winner, or valid beyond the pinned workload and scale ladder
